R9407.summary: Jörg Weinmeister, a Bavarian agent in Hungary, reports to Dukes Wilhelm IV and Ludwig X on King John's siege of Palota (Várpalota), held by László Móré, during the spring of 1533, Ferdinand standing aside after his peace with the Turk; a slip adds news that fifty thousand Turks have marched from Belgrade towards Buda.

system: System A' of KAA 4591: homophonic graphic/numeral cipher, no word division, several two-valued signs, two ligatures (h, sp) and the word sign X = F.G.; key rebuilt from the R9410 gloss key by shape, then by EM and supervised alignment.
